rationale: The previous candidate reduced kp from 9 to 7 and increased kd from 4.5 to 5 to reduce oscillations and improve damping, with a slight base speed increase from 1.3 to 1.4 to improve progress if stability was maintained. The evaluator feedback suggests further reductions in kp and increases in kd if oscillations persist, and a cautious speed increase if progress remains low but stable. Based on this, I reduce kp further to 6 and increase kd to 6 to enhance damping and reduce aggressive corrections, aiming to minimize oscillations and improve stability. I also increase base speed to 1.5 to boost progress, expecting the improved damping to maintain control at this higher speed. I keep ki at 0.5 to maintain integral action, sensor weights unchanged as no issues were reported, and line_loss strategy as 'last_direction' since it performed well. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify the effects of these changes in the next race.
